lines: Come back when you have all kanto badges.
Lorelei blocks the way. Defeat her to go on.
Bruno blocks the way. Defeat him to go on.
Agatha blocks the way. Defeat her to go on.
Lance blocks the way. Defeat him to go on.
Gary blocks the way. Defeat him and become champion!
Welcome to the Pokémon League.
I am Lorelei of the Elite Four.
No one can best me when it comes to icy Pokémon.
Freezing moves are powerful.
Your Pokémon will be at my mercy when they are frozen solid.
battle: You're better than I thought. Go on ahead. You only got a taste of the Pokémon League's power.

lines: I am Bruno of the Elite Four!
Through rigorous training, people and Pokémon can become stronger without limit.
I've lived and trained with my fighting Pokémon!
And that will never change!
battle: We will grind you down with our superior power!
My job is done. Go face your next challenge.

lines: I am Agatha of the Elite Four.
I hear Oak's taken a lot of interest in you, child.
That old duff was once tough and handsome.
But that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.
Now he just wants to fiddle with his Pokédex.
He's wrong.
Pokémon are for battling!
battle: I'll show you how a real Trainer battles!
Oh, my! You're something special, child!
You win! I see what the old duff sees in you now. I have nothing else to say. Run along now, child!

lines: I lead the Elite Four.
You can call me Lance the dragon Trainer.
You know that dragons are mythical Pokémon.
They're hard to catch and raise, but their powers are superior.
They're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.
Well, are you ready to lose?
battle: Your League challenge ends with me!
That's it! I hate to admit it, but you are a Pokémon master!
I still can't believe my dragons lost to you.

lines: Hey, I was looking forward to seeing you!
My rival should be strong to keep me sharp.
While working on my Pokédex, I looked all over for Pokémon.
Not only that, I assembled teams that would beat any Pokémon type.
And now... I'm the Pokémon League Champion!
Do you know what that means?
I'll tell you.
battle: I am the most powerful Trainer in the world!
No! That can't be! You beat me at my best! After all that work to become the League Champ?
Why? Why did I lose? I never made any mistakes raising my Pokémon... Darn it! You're the new Pokémon League Champion!

lines: Er-hem! Congratulations!
This floor is the Pokémon Hall of Fame.
Pokémon League Champions are honored for their exploits here.
Their Pokémon are also recorded in the Hall of Fame.
You have worked hard to become the new League Champion.
Congratulations, you and your Pokémon are Hall of Famers!
